title: Sex work or starve: Aid workers in Nepal left jobless by USAID cuts turn to sex work to survive - ap.org
description: Sex work or starve: Aid workers in Nepal left jobless by USAID cuts turn to sex work to survive  ap.org
publisher.title: ap.org
full_article:
A global investigations team of Kristen Gelineau, Bram Janssen and their translator Tulsi Rauniyar produced an exclusive, in-depth look at the impact the U.S. foreign aid cuts have had on the lives of laid-off aid workers in Nepal.

Gelineau, who has been covering the global impact of the cuts, turned a comment made to her in passing by an HIV researcher into a blockbuster package that revealed a shocking, darkly ironic fallout: Aid workers left jobless by the cuts who once provided HIV outreach to Nepal’s marginalized communities, including sex workers, have turned to sex work themselves to survive.

While much has been written about the devastating impacts the cuts have had on the people the funding once helped, far less is known about the impacts on the helpers themselves. Gelineau spent months working through layers of contacts to find and earn the trust of the aid workers, who are deeply traumatized after suffering frequent physical and sexual violence since turning to sex work. Because of Nepal’s conservative culture, these aid workers – who are themselves gender and sexual minorities – have no other options for work outside the sex industry.

Gelineau and visual journalist Janssen traveled to a small city in central Nepal, where they shadowed the women as they worked alongside a dangerous, dark highway. They were accompanied by their devoted translator Rauniyar, who worked with them until the wee hours of the morning for two weeks despite suffering from dengue fever.

The story was a massive hit with readers. It generated thousands of comments online and was shared tens of thousands of times. Gelineau heard from people who featured in the story who thanked her for shedding light on their situations, and also from readers who wanted to know how they could donate to support the laid-off aid workers.

The judges were impressed by the eye-opening investigation which was so sensitively told and the use of stunning visual techniques to tell people’s stories.

For a package that gave voice to a truly voiceless population and revealed an unknown, devastating impact of U.S. foreign policy half a world away, Gelineau, Janssen and Rauniyar win this week’s Best of AP – First Winner.

कटौती केरऽ वैश्विक प्रभाव क॑ कवर करै वाला गेलिन्यू न॑ एचआईवी शोधकर्ता द्वारा पास होय क॑ हुनका देलऽ गेलऽ एगो टिप्पणी क॑ ब्लॉकबस्टर पैकेज म॑ बदली देलकै जेकरा म॑ एगो चौंकाबै वाला, अन्हार विडंबनापूर्ण परिणाम के खुलासा करलऽ गेलै: एक समय म॑ सेक्स वर्कर सहित नेपाल केरऽ हाशिया प॑ पड़लऽ समुदाय क॑ एच.आई.वी.

एक तरफ जहाँ एक तरफ ई कटौती केरऽ विनाशकारी प्रभाव के बारे म॑ बहुत कुछ लिखलऽ गेलऽ छै जेकरा स॑ एक समय म॑ फंडिंग स॑ मदद मिललऽ लोगऽ प॑ पड़लऽ छै, लेकिन खुद मददगारऽ प॑ पड़ै वाला प्रभाव के बारे म॑ कहीं कम जानकारी छै । गेलिन्यू न॑ महीना भर संपर्कऽ के परतऽ के माध्यम स॑ काम करी क॑ सहायताकर्मी सिनी के विश्वास खोजै आरू अर्जित करै के काम करलकै, जे सेक्स वर्क के तरफ मुड़ला के बाद स॑ बार-बार शारीरिक आरू यौन हिंसा के शिकार होय के बाद गहराई स॑ आहत होय जाय छै । नेपाल केरऽ रूढ़िवादी संस्कृति के कारण ई सहायताकर्मी – जे खुद लैंगिक आरू यौन अल्पसंख्यक छै – के पास सेक्स उद्योग स॑ बाहर काम करै के दोसरऽ विकल्प नै छै ।

गेलिन्यू आरू दृश्य पत्रकार जानसेन मध्य नेपाल केरऽ एगो छोटऽ शहर के यात्रा करलकै, जहां वू एगो खतरनाक, अन्हार राजमार्ग के किनारे काम करतें हुअ॑ महिला सिनी प॑ छाया डाललकै । हुनका सब के साथ हुनकऽ समर्पित अनुवादक रौनियार भी छेलै, जे डेंगू के बुखार के शिकार होय के बावजूद भी दू सप्ताह तक भोर के वी घंटे तक हुनका सब के साथ काम करलकै ।

पाठकक बीच ई कथा भारी हिट भेल। एकरा ऑनलाइन हजारों कमेंट भेल आ दसों हजार बेर शेयर कएल गेल। गेलिन्यू न॑ कहानी म॑ शामिल लोगऽ स॑ सुनलकै जे हुनका धन्यवाद देलकै कि हुनी अपनऽ परिस्थिति प॑ प्रकाश डाललकै, आरू पाठकऽ स॑ भी जे ई जानना चाहै छेलै कि छंटनी करलऽ गेलऽ सहायताकर्मी सिनी के समर्थन लेली हुनी कोना दान करी सकै छै ।

जज सब आँखि खोलय बला जांच जे एतेक संवेदनशीलता स’ कहल गेल छल आ लोकक कहानी कहबा लेल आश्चर्यजनक दृश्य तकनीक के प्रयोग स’ प्रभावित छलाह.

एकटा एहन पैकेज के लेल जे सही मायने में आवाजहीन आबादी के आवाज देलक आ आधा दुनिया दूर अमेरिकी विदेश नीति के अज्ञात, विनाशकारी प्रभाव के खुलासा केलक, गेलिन्यू, जांसेन आ रौनियार एहि सप्ताह के बेस्ट ऑफ एपी – फर्स्ट विनर जीतैत छथि.

full_article: Nepal is witnessing a wave of communal violence after a dispute over loudspeakers and religious flags during a Hindu procession escalated into deadly clashes. At least three people have been killed, several injured, and curfews have been imposed in multiple areas as authorities deploy the army to restore order. The violence, which began in Sunsari district near the Indian border, has spread to other parts of the country. Prime Minister Balendra Shah has appealed for peace and communal harmony as security forces work to contain the unrest.

बढ़ैत तनाव के बीच राष्ट्रपति रामचंद्र पौडेल आ प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह शांति आ संयम के अपील केलनि। गुरुवार क॑ जारी बयान म॑ पौडेल न॑ राजनीतिक दल, नागरिक समाज केरऽ समूह आरू नागरिकऽ स॑ सामाजिक सौहार्द आरू राष्ट्रीय एकता क॑ कायम रखै के आग्रह करलकै ।

प्रधानमन्त्री शुक्रदिन महन्था ठाकुर, राजेन्द्र महतो, सी के राउत, प्रभु शाह, समीम अंसारी सहित मधेशके वरिष्ठ राजनीतिक नेतासबसँग सेहो परामर्श कए विकसित होइत स्थिति पर चर्चा केलनि । मधेश के प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला सत्ताधारी राष्ट्रिय स्वतंत्र पार्टी के संसद सदस्य सब स अलग स भेंट केलनि, जाहि में विकास कार्य आ मधेशी समुदाय के सरोकार पर केन्द्रित चर्चा भेल।

अहिना, सीमावर्ती जिल्ला सर्लाहीके जिल्ला सुरक्षा समिति सीमा पारसँ नेपालमे प्रवेश करयवला लोकके वैध परिचयपत्र लऽ कऽ जायब अनिवार्य कएने अछि, कारण संवेदनशील क्षेत्रमे अधिकारी निगरानी कडा करैत अछि ।

full_article:
The Nepal-India Chamber of Commerce & Industry (NICCI) and the European Economic Chamber (EEC Nepal), along with Bosch hosted "AI for Decision Makers – An Executive Workshop for Leaders" today. As a technology partner, Bosch played a key role in equipping local business leaders, senior executives, entrepreneurs, and policymakers to leverage Artificial Intelligence for business transformation, productivity, and strategic decision making.

“In today’s landscape, access to advanced AI technology is democratized, the differentiator now is strategic execution and leadership," said Guruprasad Mudlapur, President of the Bosch Group in India and Managing Director, Bosch Limited. "Real transformation occurs when organizations look beyond simple automation and combine AI with proprietary domain expertise, human judgment, and deep customer trust. The decisions regional leaders make today in building organizational capabilities will ultimately determine their competitiveness for years to come."

The inaugural session was also graced by H.E. Veronique Lorenzo, Ambassador of the European Union to Nepal, and H.E. Udo Eugen Volz, Ambassador of Germany to Nepal whose presence reflected the importance of international collaboration in promoting digital innovation, technology partnerships, and capacity building in Nepal's private sector.

During the inaugural session of the workshop, the AI publication titled "From Hype to Strategy - AI for Decision Makers," prepared by Bosch, was also officially launched.

“AI is no longer a future concept; it is a business imperative. The goal of this workshop was to help leaders understand how to adopt AI responsibly and turn it into measurable value for their organizations.” said Sandeep Kamat, Country Head for Bosch in Nepal.

During the Fireside Chat session of the workshop, Prof. Dr. Sudan Jha, Member of the National Planning Commission, Government of Nepal, shared the Government of Nepal's policy perspectives on Artificial Intelligence. He discussed the evolution of AI, its potential contributions to national development, how Nepal should adopt and integrate AI into its development agenda, and the initiatives the Government has already undertaken to incorporate AI into its policies and strategic plans.

The core of the workshop was facilitated by Dr. Caleb Munigety, Head of Enterprise AI at Bosch India, who drew upon Bosch’s extensive success stories to deliver a highly practical learning experience. Key sessions covered enterprise AI trends, high-impact AI opportunities, AI investments, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI governance, and actionable adoption roadmaps. Through interactive strategy exercises, senior executives from diverse sectors gained hands-on insights to seamlessly integrate AI into their long-term business planning.

The workshop marks a key milestone in the collaborative efforts of NICCI, EEC Nepal, and Bosch to strengthen leadership capacity and promote the responsible, value-oriented adoption of advanced technologies within Nepal's business ecosystem.

About The Bosch Group The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 413,000 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2025). The company generated sales of 91 billion euros in 2025. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With its business activities, the company aims to use technology to help shape universal trends such as automation, digitalization, electrification, and artificial intelligence. In this context, Bosch’s broad diversification across regions and industries strengthens its innovativeness and robustness. Bosch uses its proven expertise in hardware, software, and services to offer customers cross-domain solutions from a single source. It also applies to its expertise in connectivity and artificial intelligence in order to develop and manufacture intelligent, user-friendly, and sustainable products. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 500 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development. Bosch employs some 82,000 associate’s in research and development.

The company was set up in Stuttgart in 1886 by Robert Bosch (1861-1942) as “Workshop for Precision Mechanics and Electrical Engineering.” The special ownership structure of Robert Bosch GmbH guarantees the entrepreneurial freedom of the Bosch Group, making it possible for the company to plan over the long term and to undertake significant upfront investments in the safeguarding of its future. Ninety-four percent of the share capital of Robert Bosch GmbH is held by Robert Bosch Stiftung GmbH, a limited liability company with a charitable purpose. The remaining shares are held by Robert Bosch GmbH and by a company owned by the Bosch family. The majority of voting rights are held by Robert Bosch Industrietreuhand KG. It is entrusted with the task of safeguarding the company’s long-term existence and in particular its financial independence – in line with the mission handed down in the will of the company’s founder, Robert Bosch.

Additional information is available online at www.bosch-press.com, www.bosch.com.

भारत मँ बॉश ग्रुप के अध्यक्ष आरू बॉश लिमिटेड के प्रबंध निदेशक गुरुप्रसाद मुडलापुर नँ कहलकै, “आज के परिदृश्य मँ उन्नत एआई तकनीक के पहुँच लोकतांत्रिक छै, अंतर अब॑ रणनीतिक निष्पादन आरू नेतृत्व छै । "वास्तविक परिवर्तन तखन होयत छै जखन संगठन सरल स्वचालन स॑ परे देखै छै आरू एआई क॑ मालिकाना डोमेन विशेषज्ञता, मानवीय निर्णय, आरू गहन ग्राहक विश्वास के साथ जोड़ै छै । संगठनात्मक क्षमता के निर्माण म॑ क्षेत्रीय नेता सिनी न॑ आय जे फैसला लै छै, वू अंततः आबै वाला सालऽ लेली ओकरऽ प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता क॑ निर्धारित करतै ।"

उद्घाटन सत्रक शोभा सेहो एच.ई. नेपालमे यूरोपीय संघक राजदूत वेरोनिक लोरेन्जो आ एच.ई. नेपाल मे जर्मनीक राजदूत उडो यूजेन वोल्ज जिनकर उपस्थिति नेपालक निजी क्षेत्र मे डिजिटल नवीनता, प्रौद्योगिकी साझेदारी, आ क्षमता निर्माण केँ बढ़ावा देबा मे अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोगक महत्व केँ दर्शाबैत छल |

कार्यशाला केरऽ उद्घाटन सत्र के दौरान बॉश द्वारा तैयार करलऽ गेलऽ "फ्राम हाइप टू स्ट्रैटेजी - एआई फॉर डिसीजन मेकर्स" नाम केरऽ एआई प्रकाशन केरऽ भी आधिकारिक तौर प॑ शुभारंभ करलऽ गेलै ।

"एआई आब भविष्य केरऽ अवधारणा नै छै, ई एगो व्यापारिक अनिवार्य छै । ई कार्यशाला के लक्ष्य छेलै कि नेता सिनी क॑ ई समझै म॑ मदद मिल॑ कि एआई क॑ जिम्मेदारी स॑ कोना अपनालऽ जाय आरू ओकरा अपनऽ संगठन लेली मापऽ योग्य मूल्य म॑ बदललऽ जाय।" नेपालके बॉशके देश प्रमुख संदीप कामत बतौलनि ।

कार्यशाला के फायरसाइड चैट सत्र के दौरान नेपाल सरकार के राष्ट्रीय योजना आयोग के सदस्य प्रो. ओ एआई के विकास, राष्ट्रीय विकास में एकर संभावित योगदान, नेपाल के एआई के कोना अपनाबय आ अपन विकास एजेंडा में समाहित करबाक चाही, आ सरकार द्वारा एआई के अपन नीति आ रणनीतिक योजना में शामिल करय लेल पहिने सं कयल गेल पहल पर चर्चा केलनि।

कार्यशाला केरऽ मूल के सुविधा बॉश इंडिया केरऽ एंटरप्राइज एआई केरऽ प्रमुख डॉ. कालेब मुनिगेटी न॑ करलकै, जेकरा न॑ बॉश केरऽ व्यापक सफलता के कहानी के आधार प॑ एगो अत्यंत व्यावहारिक सीखऽ के अनुभव देलकै । प्रमुख सत्रक मे उद्यम एआई रुझान, उच्च प्रभाव वाला एआई अवसर, एआई निवेश, पैघ भाषा मॉडल (एलएलएम), एआई शासन, आ कार्यवाही योग्य अपनावय कें रोडमैप शामिल छल. इंटरैक्टिव रणनीति अभ्यास के माध्यम स॑ विविध क्षेत्रऽ के वरिष्ठ कार्यकारी न॑ एआई क॑ अपनऽ दीर्घकालिक व्यवसाय योजना म॑ निर्बाध रूप स॑ एकीकृत करै लेली हाथऽ स॑ जानकारी प्राप्त करलकै ।

ई कार्यशाला नेतृत्व क्षमता क॑ मजबूत करै आरू नेपाल केरऽ व्यापारिक पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के भीतर उन्नत तकनीकऽ के जिम्मेदार, मूल्य-उन्मुख अपनाबै क॑ बढ़ावा दै लेली निसीसी, ईईसी नेपाल, आरू बॉश केरऽ सहयोगात्मक प्रयासऽ म॑ एगो प्रमुख मील के पत्थर छेकै ।

द बॉश ग्रुप कें बारे मे बॉश ग्रुप प्रौद्योगिकी आ सेवाक कें एकटा प्रमुख वैश्विक आपूर्तिकर्ता छै. एकरऽ दुनिया भर म॑ लगभग ४१३,००० सहयोगी काम करै छै (३१ दिसंबर २०२५ तलक) । कंपनी न॑ २०२५ म॑ ९१ अरब यूरो के बिक्री करलकै ।एकरऽ परिचालन क॑ चार व्यापारिक क्षेत्रऽ म॑ विभाजित करलऽ गेलऽ छै: गतिशीलता, औद्योगिक प्रौद्योगिकी, उपभोक्ता वस्तु, आरू ऊर्जा आरू भवन प्रौद्योगिकी । अपनऽ व्यवसायिक गतिविधियऽ के साथ कंपनी केरऽ लक्ष्य छै कि स्वचालन, डिजिटलीकरण, विद्युतीकरण, आरू आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस जैसनऽ सार्वभौमिक रुझान क॑ आकार दै म॑ मदद करै लेली तकनीक के इस्तेमाल करलऽ जाय । ई संदर्भ म॑ क्षेत्र आरू उद्योगऽ म॑ बॉश केरऽ व्यापक विविधता ओकरऽ अभिनवता आरू मजबूती क॑ मजबूत करै छै । बॉश हार्डवेयर, सॉफ्टवेयर, आ सेवाक मे अपन सिद्ध विशेषज्ञता कें उपयोग ग्राहकक कें एकटा स्रोत सं क्रॉस-डोमेन समाधान प्रदान करय कें लेल करयत छै. इ बुद्धिमान, उपयोगकर्ता कें अनुकूल, आ टिकाऊ उत्पादक कें विकास आ निर्माण कें क्रम मे कनेक्टिविटी आ आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस मे अपन विशेषज्ञता पर सेहो लागू होयत छै. तकनीक के साथ जे “जीवन भर लेली आविष्कारित” छै, बॉश जीवन के गुणवत्ता म॑ सुधार आरू प्राकृतिक संसाधनऽ के संरक्षण म॑ मदद करना चाहै छै । बॉश समूह मे रॉबर्ट बॉश जीएमबीएच आ ओकर लगभग 500 सहायक आ क्षेत्रीय कंपनी शामिल छै जे 60 सं बेसि देशक मे छै. बिक्री आ सेवा भागीदार सहित, बॉश कें वैश्विक निर्माण, इंजीनियरिंग, आ बिक्री नेटवर्क दुनिया कें लगभग हर देश कें कवर करयत छै. बॉश केरऽ अभिनव ताकत कंपनी केरऽ आरू विकास केरऽ कुंजी छै । बॉश शोध आ विकास मे करीब 82,000 सहयोगी के रोजगार दैत छथिन्ह.

ई कंपनी केरऽ स्थापना स्टटगार्ट म॑ १८८६ म॑ रॉबर्ट बॉश (१८६१-१९४२) न॑ “वर्कशॉप फॉर प्रिसिजन मैकेनिक्स एंड इलेक्ट्रिकल इंजीनियरिंग” के रूप म॑ करलकै । रॉबर्ट बॉश जीएमबीएच केरऽ विशेष स्वामित्व संरचना बॉश समूह केरऽ उद्यमशीलता के स्वतंत्रता के गारंटी दै छै, जेकरा स॑ कंपनी क॑ दीर्घकालिक योजना बनाना आरू अपनऽ भविष्य के सुरक्षा म॑ महत्वपूर्ण अपफ्रंट निवेश करना संभव होय जाय छै । रॉबर्ट बॉश जीएमबीएच केरऽ 94 प्रतिशत शेयर पूंजी रॉबर्ट बॉश स्टिफतुंग जीएमबीएच के पास छै, जे एगो सीमित देयता कंपनी छै जेकरऽ धर्मार्थ उद्देश्य छै । शेष शेयर रॉबर्ट बॉश जीएमबीएच आ बॉश परिवार के स्वामित्व वाली कंपनी के पास अछि. मतदान के अधिकांश अधिकार रॉबर्ट बॉश इंडस्ट्रीट्रेउहंड केजी के पास अछि. ओकरा कंपनी केरऽ दीर्घकालिक अस्तित्व आरू खास करी क॑ ओकरऽ वित्तीय स्वतंत्रता के सुरक्षा के काम सौंपलऽ गेलऽ छै – जे कंपनी केरऽ संस्थापक रॉबर्ट बॉश केरऽ वसीयत म॑ देलऽ गेलऽ मिशन के अनुरूप छै ।

full_article:
The national identity card (NID) in Nepal is now a mandatory requirement for anyone conducting a transaction using the country’s national digital payment system.

This follows a recent Nepal Central Bank amendment to the 15th Integrated Payment System Directive, as reported by MyRepublika. The measure is part of efforts by the government to strengthen digital Know Your Customer (eKYC) for all financial operations.

According to the regulatory changes, users must link their national ID to their bank wallet service for digital payments by October 17 at the latest, after which they could face challenges.

All licensed digital finance service providers in the country have been told to verify the identity applicants against the national identity database before allowing them to open or update their wallet.

The Central Bank has said those who do not yet have ID cards must receive monthly reminders from service providers about the need to comply once they are in possession of their card.

For citizens living abroad, they can activate their wallet accounts digitally but must comply with the ID linkage requirement within a period of six months. A waiver has been granted to persons living with disabilities who are allowed to access their wallets using alternative documents if the NID is unavailable.

Officials say the move is not only intended to reduce fraud in digital payment transactions, but also to strengthen oversight of its national digital payment system to align with global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) standards set by bodies like the Financial Action Task Force (FATF).

Nepal is seeing the rapid growth of non-bank digital payment platforms which have created a potential loophole where unverified or loosely verified mobile wallets could be exploited for illicit financial flows, tax evasion, or fraud.

The move is consistent with efforts seen in other places where authorities are integrating digital identity with other public systems such as payments infrastructure or digital government platforms to financial inclusion or streamline access to public services.

India’s Aadhaar digital ID is linked to the UPI and bank accounts to enable seamless payments.

In Nigeria, the Central Bank (CBN) has long made it mandatory for all bank accounts and digital mobile wallets to be linked to verified National Identification Numbers (NIN) and the Bank Verification Numbers (BVN).

Nepal has been working to expand use cases for its national ID. An ongoing engagement with India seeks permission for cross-border acceptability of the ID card.

देश मे सबटा लाइसेंस प्राप्त डिजिटल वित्त सेवा प्रदाताक कें कहल गेल छै कि ओ पहचान आवेदक कें अपन बटुआ खोलय या अपडेट करय कें अनुमति देवय सं पहिले राष्ट्रीय पहचान डाटाबेस कें विरु द्ध सत्यापन करय.

विदेश मे रहय वाला नागरिकक कें लेल ओ अपन बटुआ खाता डिजिटल रूप सं सक्रिय कयर सकय छै मुदा छह महीना कें अवधि मे आईडी लिंकेज कें आवश्यकता कें पालन करनाय आवश्यक छै. दिव्यांगजन कें साथ रहय वाला व्यक्तियक कें माफी देल गेल छै, जेकरा वैकल्पिक दस्तावेजक कें उपयोग करयत अपन बटुआ कें उपयोग करय कें अनुमति छै अगर एनआईडी अनुपलब्ध छै.

Months after a 24-year-old MBA student from Tripura, Anjel Chakma, was fatally stabbed following a racist altercation in Dehradun, Uttarakhand police obtained an Interpol Red Corner Notice against prime accused Yagyaraj Awasthi, carrying a bounty of Rs 1 lakh.Awasthi, who fled the country shortly after the incident, is suspected to be hiding in neighbouring Nepal.The tragic incident happened on Dec 9, 2025, in Selaqui area of Dehradun, when Anjel and his younger brother, Michael, had gone to the market to buy groceries. According to the complaint, a group of men began hurling racist slurs at the brothers. When they confronted the group, the confrontation turned violent. Anjel suffered severe injuries, including stab wounds to his back, and succumbed to his injuries at a hospital on Dec 26.The brutal assault triggered widespread outrage across the country, renewing concerns over racism and safety faced by people from the Northeast.Police subsequently named six accused, including two minors, in the FIR. While five of the accused were apprehended after the incident, Awasthi managed to evade arrest and cross the border into Nepal.Vikasnagar circle officer Anuj Kumar confirmed that the Red Notice was issued following months of coordinated efforts with the ministry of external affairs.“Investigation found that he fled to Nepal after the incident and is likely still there. The Red Corner Notice will significantly expedite tracking his whereabouts and initiating his extradition to face legal action in Dehradun. We expect to apprehend him soon,” CO Kumar said.A Red Corner Notice is an international alert issued by Interpol (International Criminal Police Organisation) to locate a wanted accused and place him under provisional arrest so that he can be extradited under the legal processes of the country concerned. While it is not an arrest warrant itself, it is considered a crucial tool for coordination and action among the police agencies of member countries.

full_article:
New Delhi: Nepal is grappling with its worst outbreak of Hindu-Muslim communal violence in years after clashes that began during a religious procession spread across the Madhes, the country's southern plains bordering India, leaving at least three people dead, dozens injured and prompting curfews, army deployment and appeals for calm.

The violence, which began in the Dewanganj rural municipality in Sunsari district on July 26, has spread to several districts across the Madhes, a region where communities on both sides of the Nepal-India border share close linguistic, cultural and family ties.

While localised communal tensions are not new, researchers and security officials say the scale and rapid spread of the latest unrest mark a significant escalation.

Nearly a week after the first clashes, authorities continued to enforce curfews and prohibitory orders in several towns even as political parties, civil society organisations and religious leaders organised peace marches and interfaith meetings to prevent fresh violence. Security forces, including the Nepal Army, remain deployed across sensitive areas, while police have arrested dozens accused of participating in the riots.

How a local dispute spiralled into statewide unrest

The violence began on the evening of July 26 in Dewanganj, less than 20 kilometres from the Indian border. Thousands of Hindu devotees were returning from the Koshi barrage, where they had collected holy water as part of the annual Bol Bam pilgrimage during the month of Shravan.

Carrying saffron flags and accompanied by DJ music, the procession was making its way towards Kaptanganj Chowk, when members of the local Muslim community objected to the volume, and, by some accounts, to the placement of religious flags. As per some local reports, tensions in the area had already risen earlier that day after a Muslim flag was allegedly removed and replaced with a Hindu one.

What began as an argument soon escalated into stone-pelting between the two groups, drawing in larger crowds. As the clashes intensified, police first attempted to disperse the crowd before opening fire. One person was killed on the spot and around two dozen others, including police personnel, were injured. Authorities imposed an indefinite curfew and deployed additional units of the Armed Police Force in an effort to restore order.

The violence, however, did not end with the imposition of the curfew. Overnight, reports emerged of houses and shops being vandalised in parts of Dewanganj, while rumours and videos of the clashes spread rapidly on social media. By the following day, protests and counter-protests had begun appearing in other towns across the Madhes, transforming what had started as a local confrontation into a wider communal mobilisation.

The unrest reached another flashpoint on July 30 when a 15-year-old boy was killed in police firing during protests in Siraha. His death took the toll from police action to three and triggered fresh demonstrations, with protesters vandalising shops and commercial establishments in surrounding areas.

Over the four days, authorities imposed curfews and prohibitory orders in a string of towns, including Birgunj, Nepal's principal trading gateway with India, as tensions spread westwards across the southern plains. Security was tightened in Siraha, Mahottari, Morang and other districts, with the Nepal Army eventually joining the Nepal police and Armed Police Force in patrols aimed at preventing fresh clashes. Drone surveillance was introduced in some towns.

Despite the deployment of security agencies, protesters were still damaging properties and disturbing the major highways.

The families of those killed initially refused to accept the bodies, demanding action against the police personnel responsible as well as government compensation. It was only after negotiations with the authorities that an agreement was reached under which the government promised to declare the deceased as martyrs, provide each bereaved family with Nepali Rs 1 million in compensation and offer government employment to one eligible family member.

Although large-scale clashes had subsided by Friday, the security lockdown remained in place across several districts. Peace marches organised by local communities and religious leaders took place alongside continuing protests, illustrating both the desire to restore normalcy and the depth of mistrust that had emerged over the course of the week.

Government response under scrutiny

The government's handling of the crisis has come under criticism from opposition parties, civil society groups and political observers, who argue that the initial response was too slow to prevent the violence from spreading beyond Sunsari.

Home minister Sudan Gurung travelled to Sunsari four days after the first clashes, while Prime Minister Balendra Shah's first major public intervention came only after the violence had spread to multiple districts. Political observers questioned whether the absence of an early political outreach to community leaders had allowed tensions to escalate.

Home minister Gurung (olive shirt) in Sunsari. Photo courtesy Annapurna Post.

With the unrest widening, the government shifted into crisis-management mode. The Nepal Army was deployed in support of the Nepal police and Armed Police Force, while Shah convened the National Security Council on July 30 to review the deteriorating security situation. Local administrations imposed curfews and prohibitory orders across several districts as authorities sought to prevent further violence.

In a televised address after the agreement with the victims' families, Shah said protecting lives, preserving communal harmony and restoring peace was the government's foremost responsibility, while appealing for restraint and warning that those responsible for inciting violence would face action.

His remarks came amid growing calls for the government to address not only the immediate unrest but also the deeper causes behind Nepal's rising communal tensions.

While the prime minister was absent from public view, his own party chairman moved into the space. Rabi Lamichhane convened an all-party meeting on July 29, which neither Shah nor Gurung attended; met President Ram Chandra Paudel; and instructed his party's MPs for the affected districts to return home.

On Friday he met religious leaders at the party's parliamentary office in Singha Durbar, among them Maulana Narul Husein and Maulana Mohammad Khalid; along with Ramchandra Tiwari, general secretary of the World Hindu Federation; and Rajuraj Phuyal of the federation's secretariat, urging them to use their influence to halt the protests.

Shah told Madhes leaders on Friday that there was no distance between him and Lamichhane and that the all-party meeting had been convened by the party chairman by mutual agreement. At the meeting in Singha durbar, Shah faced pointed questions about why he had stayed silent for four to five days and why security personnel had fired above the waist.

Security agencies had warned of rising communal tensions

Long before last week's violence, Nepal's security agencies had been cautioning the country's political leadership that communal tensions in the Madhes were becoming more organised and more volatile, warning that relatively minor local disputes could quickly escalate into wider unrest.

Three years ago, the Armed Police Force, Nepal's paramilitary force tasked with border security and riot control, submitted an assessment to the government highlighting the growing vulnerability of the southern plains to communal violence.

According to local media reports, the assessment warned of organised attempts to inflame religious tensions in parts of the Madhes and recommended strengthening intelligence gathering, improving coordination among security agencies and developing mechanisms to identify potential flashpoints before they turned violent.

Similarly, the Nepal Army repeatedly flagged the possibility of communal violence in its internal assessments, reflecting concerns that religious tensions, once largely localised, could increasingly be exploited to trigger wider instability.

Why communal tensions are becoming more frequent

For much of its modern history, Nepal has witnessed relatively few episodes of organised Hindu-Muslim violence compared to many parts of South Asia. Although disputes over religious processions, places of worship and local grievances have occasionally flared into clashes, they were generally contained and rarely acquired the scale or geographical spread seen in the past week.

Researchers say that pattern has changed in recent years. A study by the Kathmandu-based Centre for Social Change documented a sharp increase in communal incidents, recording one such clash in 2022, eight in 2024, three in 2025 and 13 in the first five months of 2026 alone. While the figures do not necessarily indicate a continuous upward trend every year, they point to a marked increase in both the frequency and visibility of communal confrontations.

Conflict and governance specialist Prakash Bhattarai, who has studied the trend, says the recent violence represents a significant departure from Nepal's past. “Historically, Nepal had relatively low levels of organised religious violence compared to its South Asian neighbours, and interfaith relations have often been seen as a source of national pride,” he said. “Against this backdrop, a cluster of 37 recorded clashes in under four years, and a sharp jump in 2026, marks an important shift.”

Researchers attribute the change to a combination of factors rather than a single cause. They point to growing religious polarisation in parts of the Madhes, the rapid spread of misinformation and inflammatory content on social media, and the increasing tendency for local disputes to be framed in communal terms.

Unlike in the past, incidents in one district are now quickly amplified through online networks, allowing rumours and provocative videos to reach neighbouring towns within hours and increasing the risk of retaliatory mobilisation.

The geography of the unrest has also shaped these concerns. The Madhes's open border with India allows the easy movement of people, ideas and media, while communities on either side share languages, religious traditions and close family ties.

Analysts say that has made the region more susceptible to political and religious currents circulating across the frontier, even as they caution against reducing the recent violence to any single external influence. Instead, they argue that local grievances, weak administrative responses and broader ideological trends have interacted to create an increasingly combustible environment.

The debate over cross-border influences

The rise in communal tensions has coincided with a broader shift in Nepal's religious and political landscape over the past two decades. After the monarchy was abolished in 2008, Nepal ceased to be the world's only officially Hindu kingdom and adopted secularism, a transformation that remains contested by monarchist groups and organisations campaigning for the restoration of a Hindu state.

Against that backdrop, researchers and Nepali media have pointed to the growing visibility of organisations associated with the wider Sangh parivar in Nepal's southern plains.

The Kalam Weekly newsletter noted that the Hindu Swayamsevak Sangh (HSS), the international affiliate of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), has operated in Nepal since the 1990s and argued that its activities have become more visible in parts of the Madhes. It pointed to reports of slogans such as "Go back to Pakistan" and instances of Muslims allegedly being forced to chant "Jai Shri Ram" during recent clashes, describing them as rhetoric that had previously been uncommon in Nepal.

A 2024 report by the Center for the Study of Organised Hate similarly said organisations such as the Vishva Hindu Parishad and Bajrang Dal had expanded their presence in Nepal's Terai districts.

Separately, the US State Department's 2023 International Religious Freedom Report on Nepal recorded claims by civil society leaders that right-wing religious groups associated with India's Bharatiya Janata Party were providing financial support to influential Nepali politicians advocating the restoration of a Hindu state, while noting that no evidence had been provided to substantiate those allegations.

In an editorial published on Thursday, Himal Khabar claimed that its own investigations into communal violence in the Madhes-Tarai had found the direct and indirect involvement of the RSS through the HSS Nepal.

The magazine alleged that individuals associated with these organisations had used social media to spread provocative messages and had mobilised crowds on the ground while calling for violence against the minority community in the name of protecting religion. It further claimed that the authorities were aware of these activities but had failed to act because of the influence of individuals linked to the organisations.

मारल गेल लोकक परिवार शुरू मे लाश स्वीकार करय सं मना क देलक, जिम्मेदार पुलिसकर्मी के खिलाफ कार्रवाई के संग संग सरकारी मुआवजा के मांग केलक। अधिकारि सब स वार्तालाप के बाद ही एकटा समझौता भेल जाहि के तहत सरकार मृतक के शहीद घोषित करय के, प्रत्येक शोक संतप्त परिवार के नेपाली 10 लाख रुपया के मुआवजा देबय के आ एक पात्र परिवार के सदस्य के सरकारी रोजगार के पेशकश करय के वचन देलक।

जाँच के तहत सरकारी प्रतिक्रिया

सरकार केरऽ संकट क॑ निपटै के तरीका विपक्षी दल, नागरिक समाज केरऽ समूह आरू राजनीतिक पर्यवेक्षकऽ के आलोचना के शिकार होय गेलऽ छै, जेकरऽ तर्क छै कि शुरुआती प्रतिक्रिया बहुत धीमा छेलै जेकरा स॑ सुनसरी स॑ आगू हिंसा नै फैललऽ जाय सक॑ ।

गृहमंत्री सूडान गुरुंग पहिल झड़प के चारि दिन बाद सुनसरी गेल छलाह, जखन कि प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह के पहिल पैघ जन हस्तक्षेप तखनहि भेल छल जखन हिंसा कई जिला मे फैलल छल. राजनीतिक पर्यवेक्षक सब सवाल उठौलनि जे की समुदायक नेता तक जल्दी राजनीतिक आउटरीच नहि भेला स तनाव बढ़ि गेल अछि।

सुनसरी में गृहमंत्री गुरुंग (जैतून की शर्ट)। फोटो साभार अन्नपूर्णा पोस्ट।

अशांति बढ़लाक संग सरकार संकट-प्रबंधन मोड मे आबि गेल। नेपाल प्रहरी आ सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलके समर्थनमे नेपाली सेना तैनात कएल गेल छल, तहिना शाह ३० जुलैके राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद् बजा कऽ बिगड़ैत सुरक्षा स्थितिके समीक्षा केने छल । स्थानीय प्रशासन न॑ कई जिला म॑ कर्फ्यू आरू निषेध के आदेश लगाय देलकै, कैन्हेंकि अधिकारियऽ न॑ आरू हिंसा क॑ रोकै के कोशिश करलकै ।

पीड़ित परिवार के साथ समझौता के बाद टेलीविजन पर देलऽ गेलऽ संबोधन म॑ शाह न॑ कहलकै कि जान के रक्षा, सांप्रदायिक सौहार्द के संरक्षण आरू शांति बहाल करना सरकार केरऽ सबसें आगू के जिम्मेदारी छै, जबकि संयम के अपील करलकै आरू चेतावनी देलकै कि हिंसा भड़काबै के जिम्मेदार लोगऽ क॑ कार्रवाई के सामना करना पड़तै ।

हुनकऽ ई बात सरकार स॑ न सिर्फ तत्काल अशांति ही नै बल्कि नेपाल केरऽ बढ़तऽ साम्प्रदायिक तनाव के पाछू के गहरी कारण के भी समाधान करै के बढ़तऽ आह्वान के बीच करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

जखन कि प्रधानमंत्री जन-दृष्टि स अनुपस्थित छलाह, हुनकर अपन पार्टी क अध्यक्ष अंतरिक्ष मे आबि गेलाह। रबी लामिछाने 29 जुलाई कए सर्वदलीय बैसार बजौलथि, जाहि मे ने शाह आ ने गुरुंग शामिल भेलाह; राष्ट्रपति रामचन्द्र पौडेल सँ भेंट केलनि; आरू प्रभावित जिला केरऽ अपनऽ पार्टी केरऽ सांसदऽ क॑ घर वापसी के निर्देश देलकै ।

शुक्रदिन ओ सिंह दरबार स्थित पार्टी के संसदीय कार्यालय मे धार्मिक नेता सब सं भेंट केलनि, जाहि मे मौलाना नरुल हुसैन आ मौलाना मोहम्मद खालिद; साथ मे विश्व हिन्दू महासंघ के महासचिव रामचन्द्र तिवारी; आरू महासंघ के सचिवालय के राजराज फुलाल न॑ विरोध प्रदर्शन क॑ रोकै लेली अपनऽ प्रभाव के इस्तेमाल करै के आग्रह करलकै ।

शाह शुक्रदिन मधेशक नेतासबकेँ बतौलनि जे हुनका आ लामिछाने बीच कोनो दूरी नहि अछि आ सर्वदलीय बैसार पार्टी अध्यक्ष द्वारा आपसी सहमति सँ बजाओल गेल अछि । सिंह दरबार मे भेल बैसार मे शाह कए एहि पर नुकीला सवाल क सामना करय पड़ल जे ओ चारि-पांच दिन तक चुप किएक रहलाह आ सुरक्षाकर्मी कमर स ऊपर गोलीबारी किया केलक।

सुरक्षा एजेंसी सब सांप्रदायिक तनाव बढ़बाक चेतावनी देने छल

पिछला सप्ताह के हिंसा स बहुत पहिने नेपाल के सुरक्षा एजेंसी देश के राजनीतिक नेतृत्व के चेतावनी दैत छल जे मधेश में साम्प्रदायिक तनाव बेसी संगठित आ अस्थिर भ रहल अछि, अपेक्षाकृत छोट स्थानीय विवाद जल्दीए व्यापक अशांति में बढ़ि सकैत अछि।

तीन साल पहिने सीमा सुरक्षा आ दंगा नियंत्रण के जिम्मा देल गेल नेपाल के अर्धसैनिक बल सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल दक्षिणी मैदान के सांप्रदायिक हिंसा के प्रति बढ़ैत कमजोरी पर प्रकाश दैत एकटा आकलन सरकार के देलक।

स्थानीय मीडिया रिपोर्ट के अनुसार आकलन में मधेश के कुछ हिस्सा में धार्मिक तनाव भड़काबय के संगठित प्रयास के चेतावनी देल गेल अछि आ खुफिया जानकारी जुटाबय के काज मजबूत करय के, सुरक्षा एजेंसी के बीच समन्वय में सुधार करय के आ संभावित फ्लैशपॉइंट के हिंसक बनय सं पहिने ओकर पहचान करय के तंत्र विकसित करय के सिफारिश कायल गेल अछि.

तहिना नेपाली सेना अपन आन्तरिक आकलन मे बेर-बेर साम्प्रदायिक हिंसाक संभावना केँ झंडा देखाबैत छल जे एक बेर बहुत हद तक स्थानीयकृत धार्मिक तनावक तेजी सँ फायदा उठा कए व्यापक अस्थिरता उत्पन्न कएल जा सकैत अछि ।

साम्प्रदायिक तनाव कियैक बेसी भ रहल अछि

अपनऽ आधुनिक इतिहास केरऽ अधिकांश भाग लेली दक्षिण एशिया केरऽ बहुत भागऽ के तुलना म॑ नेपाल म॑ संगठित हिन्दू-मुस्लिम हिंसा केरऽ अपेक्षाकृत कम प्रकरण देखलऽ गेलऽ छै । हालांकि धार्मिक जुलूस, पूजा स्थल आरू स्थानीय शिकायत के विवाद बीच-बीच म॑ झड़प म॑ बदली गेलऽ छै, लेकिन सामान्य तौर प॑ ओकरा रोकलऽ गेलै आरू पिछला एक सप्ताह म॑ देखलऽ गेलऽ पैमाना या भौगोलिक प्रसार बहुत कम ही मिललै ।

शोधकर्ता के कहनाय छनि जे हाल के साल मे पैटर्न मे बदलाव आयल अछि. काठमांडू स्थित सेंटर फॉर सोशल चेंज केरऽ एगो अध्ययन म॑ साम्प्रदायिक घटना म॑ भारी वृद्धि के दस्तावेजीकरण करलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ २०२२ म॑ ऐसनऽ एक, २०२४ म॑ आठ, २०२५ म॑ तीन आरू २०२६ केरऽ पहलऽ पाँच महीना म॑ ही १३ ऐसनऽ झड़प दर्ज करलऽ गेलऽ छै । जरूरी नै छै कि ई आंकड़ा हर साल लगातार ऊपर के रुझान के संकेत दै छै, लेकिन ई सांप्रदायिक मुठभेड़ के आवृत्ति आरू दृश्यता दूनू में उल्लेखनीय वृद्धि के तरफ इशारा करै छै ।

प्रवृत्ति के अध्ययन करनिहार द्वंद्व आ शासन विशेषज्ञ प्रकाश भट्टराई के कहनाय छनि जे हाल के हिंसा नेपाल के अतीत सं एकटा महत्वपूर्ण विचलन के प्रतिनिधित्व करैत अछि. ओ कहलनि जे, ऐतिहासिक रूप स नेपाल मे दक्षिण एशियाई पड़ोसी देश क तुलना मे संगठित धार्मिक हिंसा क स्तर अपेक्षाकृत कम छल, आ अंतरधर्म संबंध कए अक्सर राष्ट्रीय गौरव क स्रोत मानल गेल अछि। “ई पृष्ठभूमि म॑ चारि साल स॑ भी कम समय म॑ ३७ के समूह न॑ टक्कर दर्ज करलकै, आरू २०२६ म॑ तेज उछाल, एगो महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव के निशानी छै ।”

शोधकर्ता सब एहि परिवर्तन के कारण एकटा कारण के बजाय कारक के संयोजन के कारण बताबैत छथि । मधेश केरऽ कुछ हिस्सा म॑ बढ़तऽ धार्मिक ध्रुवीकरण, सोशल मीडिया प॑ गलत सूचना आरू भड़काऊ सामग्री केरऽ तेजी स॑ प्रसार, आरू स्थानीय विवाद क॑ सांप्रदायिक शब्दऽ म॑ फ्रेम करै के बढ़तऽ प्रवृत्ति के तरफ इशारा करै छै ।

पहिने के विपरीत अब॑ एक जिला म॑ घटित घटना क॑ ऑनलाइन नेटवर्क के माध्यम स॑ जल्दी स॑ बढ़ालऽ जाय छै, जेकरा स॑ अफवाह आरू भड़काऊ वीडियो घंटऽ के भीतर पड़ोसी शहरऽ म॑ पहुँची जाय छै आरू प्रतिशोध के जुटान के खतरा बढ़ी जाय छै ।

अशांति के भूगोल सेहो एहि चिंता के आकार देने अछि. भारत के साथ मधेश के खुला सीमा के कारण लोगऽ, विचार आरू मीडिया के सहज आवाजाही के अनुमति मिलै छै, जबकि दोनों तरफ के समुदाय भाषा, धार्मिक परंपरा आरू घनिष्ठ पारिवारिक संबंध साझा करै छै ।

विश्लेषकऽ के कहना छै कि जेकरा स॑ ई क्षेत्र सीमा पार घूमी रहलऽ राजनीतिक आरू धार्मिक धारा के शिकार होय गेलऽ छै, यहाँ तलक कि हुनी हाल केरऽ हिंसा क॑ कोनो भी एक बाहरी प्रभाव म॑ कम करै स॑ चेतावनी दै छै । बल्कि हुनकऽ तर्क छै कि स्थानीय शिकायत, कमजोर प्रशासनिक प्रतिक्रिया आरू व्यापक वैचारिक प्रवृत्ति न॑ एक दोसरा के साथ मिल क॑ तेजी स॑ दहनशील वातावरण पैदा करलकै ।

सीमा पारक प्रभाव पर बहस

साम्प्रदायिक तनाव मे वृद्धि पिछला दू दशक मे नेपालक धार्मिक आ राजनीतिक परिदृश्य मे व्यापक परिवर्तनक संग संयोग सँ भेल अछि । २००८ मे राजतंत्र समाप्त भेलाक बाद नेपाल विश्वक एकमात्र आधिकारिक हिन्दू राज्य नहि रहि गेल आ धर्मनिरपेक्षता अपना लेलक, जे परिवर्तन राजतंत्रवादी समूह आ हिन्दू राज्यक पुनर्स्थापनक अभियान चलाबयवला संस्था द्वारा विवादित अछि ।

ओहि पृष्ठभूमि मे शोधकर्ता आ नेपाली मीडिया नेपालक दक्षिणी मैदान मे व्यापक संघ परिवार सँ जुड़ल संगठनक बढ़ैत दृश्यता दिस इशारा केने छथि ।

कलाम साप्ताहिक समाचारपत्र मे राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ (आरएसएस) केर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोगी हिन्दू स्वयंसेवक संघ (एचएसएस) नेपाल मे 90 के दशक सँ संचालित होइत रहल आ तर्क देल गेल अछि जे मधेशक किछु भाग मे ओकर गतिविधि बेसी देखबा मे आबि गेल अछि । एहि मे "पाकिस्तान वापस जाउ" जेहन नारा आ हालक झड़प के दौरान मुसलमान के कथित तौर पर "जय श्री राम" के नारा लगेबाक उदाहरण के तरफ इशारा करैत एकरा एहन बयानबाजी बतौल गेल जे पहिने नेपाल मे असामान्य छल ।

संगठित नफरत के अध्ययन केन्द्र के 2024 के रिपोर्ट में सेहो एहिना कहल गेल अछि जे विश्व हिन्दू परिषद आ बजरंग दल सन संस्था नेपाल के तराई जिला में अपन उपस्थिति बढ़ा देलक अछि।

अलग-अलग अमेरिकी विदेश विभाग केरऽ २०२३ केरऽ नेपाल केरऽ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता रिपोर्ट म॑ नागरिक समाज केरऽ नेता सिनी के दावा दर्ज करलऽ गेलऽ छै कि भारत केरऽ भारतीय जनता पार्टी स॑ जुड़लऽ दक्षिणपंथी धार्मिक समूह हिन्दू राज्य केरऽ बहाली के वकालत करै वाला प्रभावशाली नेपाली राजनेता सिनी क॑ आर्थिक सहायता द॑ रहलऽ छै, जबकि ई नोट करलऽ गेलऽ छै कि वू आरोपऽ क॑ पुष्ट करै लेली कोय सबूत नै उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

बृहस्पतिदिन प्रकाशित सम्पादकीयमे हिमल खबर मधेश-तराईमे साम्प्रदायिक हिंसाके अपन अनुसन्धानमे एचएसएस नेपालके माध्यमसँ संघके प्रत्यक्ष आ परोक्ष संलग्नता पाओल गेल दाबी केने छथि ।

पत्रिका के आरोप छै कि ई संगठनऽ स॑ जुड़लऽ व्यक्ति न॑ सोशल मीडिया के इस्तेमाल करी क॑ भड़काऊ संदेश फैलाबै के काम करलकै आरू धर्म के रक्षा के नाम प॑ अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय के खिलाफ हिंसा के आह्वान करतें हुअ॑ जमीन प॑ भीड़ जुटान॑ छेलै । आगू दावा करलौ गेलौ छै कि अधिकारियौ क ई सब गतिविधि के बारे मँ पता छेलै लेकिन संगठनौ स॑ जुड़लौ व्यक्ति सिनी के प्रभाव के वजह स॑ हुनी काम नै करी सकलऽ छै ।

ई लेख एकतीस जुलाई, दू हजार छब्बीस, राति मे एगारह बजे अड़तीस मिनट पर लाइव भेल।

तार आब व्हाट्सएप पर अछि। नवीनतम घटनाक्रम पर तीक्ष्ण विश्लेषण आ राय के लेल हमर चैनल के फॉलो करू।

title: Hindu mobs attack mosques, Muslim properties as violence spreads in Nepal - Muslim Network TV
description: Hindu mobs attack mosques, Muslim properties as violence spreads in Nepal  Muslim Network TV
publisher.title: Muslim Network TV
full_article:
KATHMANDU, Nepal (MNTV) — Hindu mobs have attacked mosques, Muslim-owned businesses and homes across southern Nepal as communal violence that began in Sunsari district spread into neighboring areas, leaving at least three people dead and prompting sweeping curfews.

Videos from several locations show mobs setting fire to shops and religious sites, looting Muslim-owned businesses and assaulting people identified as Muslims.

In several clips, attackers can be heard chanting “Jai Shri Ram,” or “Victory to Lord Rama,” a Hindu religious slogan increasingly used as a rallying cry by Hindu nationalist groups across South Asia.

One video shows a mob placing a Muslim skullcap on a stick before setting it on fire as people gather around it. The skullcap is widely worn by Muslim men across South Asia and serves as a visible marker of religious identity.

In Nepal’s southeastern Sunsari district, footage recorded on July 29 shows a Muslim-owned vehicle repair shop engulfed in flames while members of the crowd chant “Jai Shri Ram.”

At Phool Chowk in Bhokraha Narsingh Rural Municipality, a mob attacked a shop belonging to Muslim man Siraj Ansari. Videos show extensive damage inside the business, with merchandise scattered and shelves emptied. Local accounts said cash and goods worth hundreds of thousands of Nepali rupees were stolen.

A historic mosque in Koshi Rural Municipality was also vandalized during the violence. Members of the Hindu Samrat Sena were accused of entering the mosque, burning copies of the Quran and assaulting an elderly Muslim man and woman present inside. They were also reportedly forced to chant Hindu religious slogans.

The attacks spread into neighboring Siraha district, where a mob targeted a mosque during a Hindu nationalist protest in Golbazar and set parts of the building on fire. Videos show flames and smoke rising from the religious site as crowds gather outside.

In the nearby Balkawa area, the home of Shoaib Anwar, the elected chair of Ward 12 in Golbazar Municipality, was also set ablaze during the unrest.

Footage from Kaptanganj shows a Muslim family traveling on a motorcycle being stopped and beaten by a mob before police officers intervene and pull them away.

Another video from Kasaha in Siraha district shows a Muslim man being assaulted in front of police personnel, who later step in to stop the attack.

The wave of attacks followed communal clashes that erupted in Sunsari on July 26 after a dispute over loud music and religious flags during a Hindu event escalated into stone-throwing and police firing. The unrest subsequently spread into parts of Madhesh Province.

Two men were killed in Sunsari and a third person was shot dead in Siraha as sporadic clashes continued. At least 25 others were injured in the initial violence, while curfews were imposed across parts of Sunsari, Siraha, Dhanusha and other districts.

Hundreds of security personnel, including soldiers, were deployed as markets closed, schools suspended classes and residents remained confined to their homes.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah addressed the country on Thursday night, four days after the violence began, promising an impartial investigation and punishment for those responsible.

काठमाण्डू, नेपाल, मिथिला मिरर: सुनसरी जिलासँ शुरू भेल साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा पड़ोसी इलाकामे पसरि गेलाक बाद दक्षिण नेपालमे मस्जिद, मुस्लिम स्वामित्वक ​​व्यवसाय आ घरमे हिन्दू भीड़ आक्रमण केलक अछि ।

कई जगहऽ के वीडियो म॑ भीड़ न॑ दोकान आरू धार्मिक स्थलऽ प॑ आग लगाय क॑ मुसलमानऽ के स्वामित्व वाला व्यवसायऽ म॑ लूटपाट करी क॑ मुसलमान के रूप म॑ पहचानलऽ गेलऽ लोगऽ प॑ हमला करी क॑ देखै छै ।

कई क्लिपऽ म॑ हमलावरऽ क॑ “जय श्री राम” या “भगवान राम केरऽ विजय” के नारा लगैलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै, जे हिन्दू धार्मिक नारा छेकै जेकरऽ इस्तेमाल पूरा दक्षिण एशिया म॑ हिन्दू राष्ट्रवादी समूहऽ द्वारा जुटान के चिल्लाहट के रूप म॑ तेजी स॑ करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

एकटा वीडियो मे देखल गेल अछि जे एकटा भीड़ मुस्लिम खोपड़ी के टोपी के लाठी पर राखि क ओकरा आगि लगाबय सं पहिने ओकरा चारू कात लोक जमा भ गेल अछि. खोपड़ी केरऽ टोपी पूरा दक्षिण एशिया म॑ मुस्लिम पुरुष व्यापक रूप स॑ पहनै छै आरू धार्मिक पहचान केरऽ दृश्यमान निशान के काम करै छै ।

नेपाल केरऽ दक्षिण पूर्वी सुनसरी जिला म॑ २९ जुलाई क॑ रिकॉर्ड करलऽ गेलऽ फुटेज म॑ मुसलमानऽ के स्वामित्व वाला वाहन मरम्मत के दोकान म॑ आग के लपट स॑ डूबलऽ देखलऽ गेलऽ छै जबकि भीड़ के सदस्य “जय श्री राम” के नारा लगाबै छै ।

भोकराहा नरसिंह गाउँपालिकाके फूल चौकमे मुस्लिम पुरुष सिराज अंसारीके दोकानमे भीड़ आक्रमण केलक अछि । वीडियो में व्यवसाय के अंदर व्यापक नुकसान देखल गेल अछि, जाहि में माल बिखरि गेल अछि आ अलमारी खाली भ गेल अछि. स्थानीय खाता मे लाखों नेपाली रुपैयाक नगद आ सामान चोरी भेल जानकारी देल गेल अछि ।

हिंसा के दौरान कोशी ग्रामीण नगरपालिका के ऐतिहासिक मस्जिद में सेहो तोड़फोड़ कायल गेल। हिन्दू सम्राट सेना के सदस्य सब पर मस्जिद में घुसि क कुरान के प्रति जरा क अंदर मौजूद एकटा बुजुर्ग मुस्लिम पुरुष आ महिला के संग मारपीट करबाक आरोप छल। खबर छै कि हुनका सब क॑ हिन्दू धार्मिक नारा लगाबै लेली भी मजबूर करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

ई हमला पड़ोसी सिरहा जिला म॑ भी फैललऽ छेलै, जहां गोलबाजार म॑ हिन्दू राष्ट्रवादी विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान भीड़ न॑ एगो मस्जिद क॑ निशाना बना क॑ भवन केरऽ कुछ हिस्सा म॑ आग लगाय देलकै । वीडियो मे धार्मिक स्थल सं लपट आ धुआं उठैत देखाओल गेल अछि, जखन कि बाहर भीड़ जमा भ रहल अछि.

पास के बालकवा इलाका में गोलबाजार नगरपालिका के वार्ड 12 के निर्वाचित अध्यक्ष शोएब अनवर के घर में सेहो अशांति के दौरान आगि लगा देल गेल।

कपतानगंज केरऽ फुटेज म॑ देखलऽ गेलऽ छै कि मोटरसाइकिल प॑ सवार एगो मुस्लिम परिवार क॑ भीड़ द्वारा रोकी क॑ पीटलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै, जेकरा बाद पुलिस अधिकारी हस्तक्षेप करी क॑ ओकरा खींच॑ छै ।

सिराहा जिला केरऽ कसाहा केरऽ एगो आरू वीडियो म॑ देखलऽ गेलऽ छै कि पुलिसकर्मी के सामने एगो मुस्लिम आदमी प॑ हमला करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै, जेकरा बाद म॑ हमला रोकै लेली बीच में आबी रहलऽ छै ।

हमला के ई लहर 26 जुलाई क॑ सुनसरी म॑ हिन्दू आयोजन के दौरान जोर-जोर स॑ संगीत आरू धार्मिक झंडा के विवाद के बाद पथराव आरू पुलिस केरऽ गोलीबारी म॑ बदली गेलऽ सांप्रदायिक झड़प के बाद आबी गेलऽ छै । तत्पश्चात मधेश प्रान्तक किछु भाग मे अशांति पसरल ।

छिटपुट झड़प जारी रहला के कारण सुनसरी में दू आदमी के मौत आ सिराहा में तेसर व्यक्ति के गोली मारल गेल। प्रारम्भिक हिंसामे कमसँ कम २५ गोटे घायल भेल अछि, तहिना सुनसरी, सिराहा, धनुषा आ अन्य जिल्लाके किछु भागमे निषेधाज्ञा लगाओल गेल अछि ।

बाजार बंद, स्कूल कक्षा बंद आ निवासी घर मे बंद रहला स सैनिक सहित सैकड़ों सुरक्षाकर्मी कए तैनात कैल गेल।

प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह हिंसा शुरू भेलाक चारि दिन बाद गुरुवार राति देश कए संबोधित करैत निष्पक्ष जांच आ जिम्मेदार कए सजा देबाक वादा केलथि।

title: Nepal curfew widens to fourth district as communal tensions spread - AzerNews
description: Nepal curfew widens to fourth district as communal tensions spread  AzerNews
publisher.title: AzerNews
full_article:
Nepalese authorities on Friday imposed an indefinite curfew in parts of Saptari district in Madhesh province after protests broke out over the recent communal violence in neighbouring Sunsari. The move came as tensions continued in several districts, with curfews and prohibitory orders already in place in parts of Sunsari, Dhanusha and Siraha, taking the number of districts under curfew to four, AzerNEWS reports via IndiaToday.

President Ram Chandra Paudel and Prime Minister Balendra Shah expressed deep concern over the situation and appealed for calm, unity and restraint. Police said eight people had been arrested in Madhesh province for their alleged involvement in spreading communal violence, including five from Siraha and three from Dhanusha.

The District Administration Office in Saptari imposed the curfew in parts of Rajbiraj municipality from 8 am as a precaution after groups of people staged protests in response to the clashes. Authorities have stepped up security deployment in Nepal's southern Terai region along the Indian border as they try to contain tensions that have claimed three lives so far.

The violence began in Sunsari in Koshi province on Sunday, when members of two religious communities holding separate programmes clashed over the use of loudspeakers and the display of religious flags. Police intervened after a verbal altercation turned violent. One person was killed and more than a dozen people, including security personnel, were injured when police opened fire to disperse the clashing groups.

राष्ट्रपति रामचन्द्र पौडेल आ प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह स्थिति पर गहींर चिन्ता व्यक्त करैत शान्त, एकता आ संयम के अपील केलथि । मधेश प्रदेशमे साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा फैलाबैमे कथित संलग्नताके आरोपमे आठ गोटेके सिराहाके ५ आ धनुषाके ३ गोटेके गिरफ्तार कएलगेल प्रहरी जनौलक अछि ।

सप्तरीके जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय राजविराज नगरपालिकाके कुछ भागमे भोर ८ बजेसे निषेधाज्ञाके क्रममे झडपके प्रतिक्रियामे समूहसभके विरोध प्रदर्शन केलाक बाद सप्तरीके जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालयमे निषेधाज्ञा लगाओल गेल अछि । भारतीय सीमा पर नेपाल के दक्षिणी तराई क्षेत्र में अधिकारि सब सुरक्षा तैनाती के तेज क देलक अछि, कियाकि ओ तनाव के रोकय के कोशिश करैत अछि जाहि में एखन धरि तीन गोटे के जान गेल अछि।

कोशी प्रांत के सुनसरी में रविदिन हिंसा शुरू भेल छल, जखन कि अलग-अलग कार्यक्रम आयोजित करय वाला दू धार्मिक समुदाय के सदस्य लाउडस्पीकर के प्रयोग आ धार्मिक झंडा के प्रदर्शन के ल क झड़प भ गेल छल। मौखिक बकझक हिंसक भ गेलाक बाद पुलिस हस्तक्षेप केलक। झड़पैत समूह के तितर-बितर करय लेल पुलिस गोलीबारी केलाक बाद एक गोटे के मौत भ गेल आ सुरक्षाकर्मी सहित दर्जन सं बेसी लोक घायल भ गेल।
